description: What a part-time job does to an unemployment benefit in Finland: the benefit falls by 50 cents per euro earned (since 1 April 2024, not below zero), and the result gives the gross total, the net pay of the earnings and the gross gain compared with not working. The benefit's own tax withholding is not estimated. Rules are versioned and some points are flagged as still to verify (notes contains yleistuki_unverified when that applies). An estimate, not an official decision. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
